question: List 10 distinct employees where status_class is not 'T'. Return columns: employee_id, client_id, client_name, employment_type, status_class. Order by client_id, employee_id.
sql:
SELECT sv.employee_id, sv.client_id, sv.client_name, sv.employment_type, sv.status_class
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    DWH_AI_DEV.ENG_SEMANTIC.SV_EMPLOYEE_WORKFORCE
    FACTS employee.employee_id, client.client_id, client.client_name, employee.employment_type, employee.status_class
    WHERE employee.status_class <> 'T'
) AS sv
ORDER BY sv.client_id, sv.employee_id NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
